decisions.briefing: Market was neutral today with NASDAQ -0.4% and S&P 500 -0.2%, showing no strong directional signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new positions were opened. Holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup before deploying capital.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, in the absence of any single dominant catalyst. Trading stayed cautious and range-bound as investors weighed mixed signals without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger. The modest pullback reflects a pause rather than a shift in trend, consistent with a neutral market backdrop.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅走軟，納斯達克指數下跌0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.2%，市場缺乏明確的單一催化因素。投資人在缺乏清晰風險偏好訊號的情況下保持謹慎，走勢维持在窄幅區間內。這波溫和回調更像是短暫喘息，而非趨勢轉向，符合整體中性市況。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to be deployed when a strong opportunity appears. Today, with cash below the buy threshold and the market showing no clear risk-on signal, holding cash rather than forcing a trade is a disciplined use of dry powder.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指留在場邊、隨時準備在出現絕佳機會時投入的現金。今天現金餘額低於買入門檻，且市場沒有明確的風險偏好訊號，因此保留現金而非勉強交易，正是善用乾火藥的紀律表現。
